home.title: Jorge Ángel Páez
home.subtitle: Software Developer • Systems Architecture • AI & Embedded Systems
home.description: Software developer focused on efficient systems, scalable backend architectures, and data-driven intelligent platforms. I work on the design and implementation of secure and scalable systems, with a focus on performance, reliability, and resource-constrained environments.
home.descriptionExtended: I develop backend services using Go, Python, and Java, and build AI-assisted platforms leveraging vector databases and RAG architectures. In parallel, I design embedded and IoT solutions in C/C++, integrating hardware with distributed systems. My interests include implementing encryption layers, secure data transmission, and building robust architectures aligned with MIL-STD-810 standards.
